summary: The agent failed the budget-reconciliation-pivot task despite producing all 6 sheets. The existing sales-pivot-analysis skill covers the general workflow but lacks budget-specific patterns: wide-to-long budget transformation, budget reconciliation derived columns (VARIANCE, UTILIZATION_PCT), and org-hierarchy PDF joins. Adding a Budget Reconciliation domain variant and a wide-to-long transformation script will prevent future agents from rediscovering these patterns.
